title: GenISys: Integrated Ship Systems Design Using Subsystem-Conditional Tabular Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.11622v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ship design requires coordinating coupled subsystems to satisfy engineering constraints and balance competing performance and cost objectives. Generative artificial intelligence has supported component design, but integrated ship generation must also account for interactions among hull geometry, structure, propulsion, and operation. This paper presents GenISys, a framework for generating integrated systems, demonstrated through early-stage bulk-carrier design. Its dataset contains 217,999 proposed designs, including 16,247 that satisfy the formulated engineering constraints. The proposed simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) generates subsystems together, allowing each subsystem model to respond to changes elsewhere during generation. Experiments compare this approach with monolithic whole-ship generation and sequential subsystem generation across five independent training runs per architecture. In

translated_title: GenISys：基于子系统条件化表格扩散的集成船舶系统设计
translated_abstract: 船舶设计需要协调相互耦合的子系统，以满足工程约束并平衡性能与成本之间相互竞争的目标。生成式人工智能已能支持部件级设计，但集成船舶的生成还必须考虑船体几何、结构、推进与运行之间的相互作用。本文提出GenISys，一个用于生成集成系统的框架，并通过散货船早期设计加以演示。其数据集包含217,999个设计方案，其中16,247个满足所制定的工程约束。所提出的同步条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM）可同时生成各子系统，使每个子系统模型在生成过程中能够响应其他部分的变化。实验将该方法与单体整船生成和顺序子系统生成进行对比，每种架构均进行五次独立训练运行。
tldr: 提出GenISys框架及同步条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM），通过同时生成相互耦合的船舶子系统，实现满足工程约束的集成船舶早期设计。
en_tdlr: GenISys proposes a simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) that generates coupled ship subsystems jointly, enabling integrated early-stage ship design that satisfies engineering constraints.
